run_interop_tests: run gRPC cross-language interop tests in parallel across multiple languages using docker containers
build_docker_image: build a docker image for a specific language's gRPC interop test client or server
cloud_to_prod_jobspec: create a jobspec for running cloud-to-prod gRPC interop tests against production servers
cloud_to_cloud_jobspec: create a jobspec for running cloud-to-cloud gRPC interop tests between local docker containers
aggregate_http2_results: parse and aggregate HTTP/2 interop test results from stdout into a summary dictionary
